maria_cs: Lumina onboarding seeing sudden 429s right after SDK session create. Happens when they run their parallel smoke (15-30 inits).
ben_engineer: any sample logs?
maria_cs: they sent this snippet: 
```
POST /v1/sessions -> 200
send header x-client-telemetry: v=1;env=staging;session=zzz
POST /v1/generate -> 429 rate_limit
```
jess_sre: classic hot-shard. identical telemetry header values + concurrent inits map to same upstream shard; upstream rate limiter returns 429.
ben_engineer: we pushed a config that accidentally included the telemetry header in the hash key for some edge pools.
lucas_infra: quick workaround: I can add a tenant-scoped edge rule to exclude x-client-telemetry from consistent-hash for lumina-123. Canary first (5%).
ben_engineer: parallel fix: SDK patch to stop sending telemetry on blocking init and instead send it async with jitter (will reduce identical header fanout). I'll prepare 0.9.3 patch.
jess_sre: guardrails: make edge rule time-limited (48h), monitor per-tenant queue depth, and rollback if imbalance shows.
maria_cs: Lumina prefers we do the edge canary now so they can continue onboarding. I'll ask them to reduce parallel inits to <8 until canary is healthy. 20m call scheduled.
deploy-bot: PR-5101 canary deploy queued by lucas_infra
maria_cs: action items recap: lucas_infra -> canary edge rule PR-5101 (5% -> 100%) ; ben_engineer -> SDK 0.9.3 patch to background telemetry ; jess_sre -> monitor alerts & rollback conditions ; maria_cs -> coordinate customer throttle and confirm after canary.
maria_cs: will paste post-call logs here. :thumbsup:
